hardware.device: AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 395 / Radeon 8060S Graphics

candidate.name: exact per-layer sparse-FFN HIP graph replay
candidate.scope: Capture each of 47 stateless sparse FFNs as one graph containing the existing router, selector, selected expert, shared expert, and tail kernels.
candidate.capture_validation: A one-time host snapshot/restore is required because the sparse FFN consumes scratch.norm and its tail overwrites that same allocation with the next layer's norm. Normal graph replay has no host copy.

trace_protocol.command: GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=2 HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. rocprofv3 --kernel-trace --output-format csv --output-directory /tmp/laguna-sparse-ffn-graph-fixed-trace.lrOcZs --output-file graph -- .venv/bin/python3 -u scripts/laguna_long_context_profile.py --context-length 4096 --lengths 512 --chunk-size 2048 --decode-output-tokens 128 --repetitions 1 --warmup-rows 128 --compiler-version-file /tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt --require-cached-build --compare-sparse-ffn-graph --allow-dirty --output /tmp/laguna-sparse-ffn-graph-fixed-trace.lrOcZs/bench.json
trace_protocol.segmentation: The final two groups of 127 exact 482-dispatch embedding-through-argmax segments are control then candidate. Report medians within each group.

decision.result: Reject and remove all Laguna graph integration, comparison CLI, and tests.
decision.reason: Fully engaged HIP graph replay does not shrink the measured internal queue gaps, adds 0.178277 ms/token of idle, and loses 0.478421% in the unprofiled directional wall screen.
decision.retained_fix: Commit 91f18831d preserves only the generic graph-validation input restore and its live HIP correctness gate; it does not change Laguna production.
decision.closed_work: Do not reopen per-layer HIP graph replay as a Laguna dispatch optimization.
decision.reopen_criterion: Require a lower-level command owner that demonstrably prequeues work, a whole-token graph with dynamic device-owned state, or actual device-kernel fusion.
